summary: Frontend-only end-to-end test of FacturaFlow SPA. All 17 core scenarios from the review request passed: layout+demo prefill, live updates for emitter/client/metadata, add/remove line items, totals math (no discount, percent discount, fixed discount), VAT recompute, currency switcher (DZD/EUR/USD with correct symbol+position), trilingual UI (FR/EN/AR) with RTL for Arabic, logo upload/remove, PDF download (file named FAC-2026-001.pdf), window.print invocation, new-invoice increment while preserving emitter, reset-profile dialog confirm restores defaults, and localStorage persistence across reload with facturaflow_ prefixed keys.
critical_code_review_comments: computeTotals: When discountType='fixed' and discount > subtotal, discountAmount is clamped, which is correct. Good.
nextInvoiceNumber correctly increments trailing digits with zero padding (FAC-2026-001 -> FAC-2026-002).
LocalStorage persistence works with facturaflow_ prefix as expected.
Preview uses CSS transform scaling; A4 preview stays within one page for 3-item demo (verified visually).
Minor: date input relies on browser native picker (acceptable per requirements), UI is dark-themed and consistent.
Minor code smell: useLayoutEffect(recompute) runs on every render without deps — mitigated by internal diff check, but could be tightened.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17 review-request scenarios were exercised via Playwright against the public preview URL. Totals math validated with concrete numbers: subtotal=200 DA, VAT 20% -> 40 DA -> 240 DA; with 10% discount -> 36 DA VAT / 216 DA total; with fixed 50 discount -> 30 DA VAT / 180 DA total. Currency formatting verified: '200,00 DA', '180,00 €', '$180.00'. Arabic switches document.documentElement.dir to 'rtl' and translates the preview (فاتورة). New invoice increments FAC-2026-042 -> FAC-2026-043 while emitter name persists. PDF download event captured with filename FAC-2026-001.pdf. LocalStorage keys observed: facturaflow_invoice, facturaflow_lang, facturaflow_currency, facturaflow_profile. No console errors, no backend calls (as expected).
